chancellor.name: Chairman
chancellor.message:
Tokyo International Seminary has actively launched cooperative ministries in response to God's calling for the Japanese church in this era, signing an MOU with the Reformed General Assembly and Sudokukje Graduate University.
This is a union of faith to raise up pastors equipped with the Word, theology, and field experience for the recovery of Japanese denominations and churches without pastors.

Our school stands firmly on biblical reformed theology and intends to clearly fulfill its mission as a seminary that trains pastors who revitalize churches and ministers who restore the field.
Furthermore, we declare that we will prepare missional leaders to preach the Gospel in a multi-ethnic and multi-cultural society, obey the Lord's Great Commission to make disciples of all nations, and advance toward world evangelization.

Believing that God, who began this work, will personally guide and complete it, Tokyo International Seminary will remain faithful to the end as an instrument serving the Japanese church and the nations.

philosophy.title: Education Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: Education Philosophy
philosophy.item1: 1. Sola Scriptura: The standard for all education and ministry is the Word of God.
philosophy.item2: 2. Solus Christus: We build the church and ministers centering on Christ.
philosophy.item3: 3. Sola Gratia: We educate for a life of calling received by grace.
philosophy.item4: 4. Sola Fide: We train for ministry and mission lived out by faith.
philosophy.item5: 5. Soli Deo Gloria: The purpose of all education is the glory of God.
